mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (category, title, message, target_type, target_id, created_at) VALUES (#{category}, #{title}, #{message}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO notification_receiver (notification_id, account_id, is_read, read_at) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{accountId}, 0, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE branch_code = 1

SELECT po.po_id AS poId, po.po_no AS poNo, po.branch_code AS branchCode, b.name AS branchName, po.total_material_cnt AS totalMaterialCnt FROM place_order po JOIN branch b ON po.branch_code = b.branch_code WHERE po.po_no = #{poNo}
